subject: Parity sprint & acceptance guardrails — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@optimapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Parity sprint & acceptance guardrails — next steps

Hi Alex / Sofia —

Thanks again for a productive discovery today. Quick recap and a proposed two-week parity sprint so we can quantify whether an open model can meet OptimaPay's enforcement/extraction bar against the proprietary baseline you shared.

Call highlights (TL;DR):
- Target integration: claim extraction + short-form justification generation from transaction notes (batch throughput secondary)
- Current proprietary baseline: OptimaPay-prop-v2 (sample outputs in baseline-sample-output.csv)
- Key pain: occasional hallucinations on edge legal language and missing fine-grained assertion tags that your regression tests catch

Proposal (parity sprint, 2 weeks):
1) Models to trial (running on Redwood hosted trial):
   - HF/open-instruct-xxl (float, baseline run)
   - Llama-3-70b-qat (int4 quantized candidate)
   - Redwood-tuned-lite (candidate tuned for extraction prompts)
   - Fallback: opti-prop-compat (when strict SLOs required)

2) Evaluation buckets & acceptance criteria (we should agree these up front):
   - Extraction recall (entity/assertion recall) >= 0.80 vs your labeled set
   - Precision on legal-clauses classification >= 0.82
   - Hallucination rate (false assertions per 1k outputs) < 3%
   - Latency p95 under Dedicated trial profile <= 650ms (for live throughput estimate)

3) Artifacts we will share to run the sprint: prompt_set_v1.jsonl (canonical prompts + shot examples), benchmark-instructions.pdf (how to run the harness), and a HubSpot task with eval milestones.

Immediate asks from you:
- Confirm the labeled evaluation set we should use (or point to Drive link)
- Do you want token-level cost sensitivity included in the report? We can show trade-offs with quantized variants

Next steps I propose this week:
- I’ll upload the prompt bundle + benchmark instructions (attached).
- You confirm dataset link and acceptance thresholds by Tue 2026-09-22.
- Redwood kicks off ingest + 4-model run; interim readout after 7 days.

Thanks — excited to make this concrete.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: prompt_set_v1.jsonl (prompt bundle), benchmark-instructions.pdf (test harness guide)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@optimapay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@optimapay.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Parity sprint & acceptance guardrails — next steps

Ben —

Thanks for the clear plan and the artifacts. A few clarifying points from our side: 

- We can give you a 12k labeled set in Drive (I'll share link after checking confidentiality scopes). That set includes the edge-case legal snippets we flagged.
- Acceptance thresholds: your proposed numbers look reasonable but leadership wants to see recall >= 0.82 on the contract-clauses slice specifically (not just overall). Can you surface per-slice metrics in the sprint report?
- Hallucination definition: for us, ‘false assertion’ counts if a generated assertion is not present in the source text OR contradicts it. Please document how you detect that in the harness.

On retention/security: we need confirmation that any examples used for probe runs are not retained beyond the sprint in the hosted sandbox. If acceptable, we can proceed without a Private deployment for the trial.

We agree to the two-week sprint. Please: 
1) Share final prompt bundle + instructions to our Drive folder.
2) Confirm the per-slice metric breakdown and whether you’ll include cost-per-inference estimates for quantized runs.

Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Product — OptimaPay
alex.turner@optimapay.com

On Tue, Sep 21, 2026 at 09:04 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again, Alex — will action items below.
>
> —Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@optimapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Parity sprint & acceptance guardrails — next steps

Alex / Sofia —

Good questions — short answers and commitments: 

- Per-slice metrics: yes, we’ll break down recall/precision/hallucination for the contract-clauses slice, numeric-amounts slice, and free-text notes slice.
- Hallucination detection: our harness computes a conservative false-assertion signal by exact-match and fuzzy-string checks against gold tokens plus a contradiction heuristic. We’ll document thresholds in the benchmark-instructions.pdf.
- Data retention: Redwood hosted trial can be configured to not persist examples (ephemeral ingest) and we’ll provide a signed trial data-processing note. If you need Private, we can scope that but it will add time/cost.
- Cost estimates: included — we’ll report tokenized cost per 1k requests for int4 quantized runs vs float baseline.

Adjusted acceptance ask (to align with leadership):
- Contract-clauses recall >= 0.82
- Overall extraction recall >= 0.80
- Precision on clauses >= 0.84
- Hallucination rate < 2.5% (tightened per legal constraint)

Operational plan:
- Wed 09/23: we upload prompt_set_v1.jsonl and benchmark harness; you confirm Drive access
- Thu 09/24: Redwood kicks off model runs; mid-sprint readout by 09/30; final report by 10/06

If that schedule works I’ll create the HubSpot milestone and schedule a 30m interim readout next Thursday.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: baseline-sample-output.csv (optimapay example outputs)

Subject: Internal: OptimaPay parity sprint — task list

Team — internal action items (post-confirmation from OptimaPay expected today):

1) Engineering (Priyom) — ingest opt-in Drive set into ephemeral sandbox; wire up harness with per-slice reporting (contract-clauses / numeric-amounts / free-text). Deliver by 2026-09-24 EOD.
2) Eval (Marissa) — run initial control pass on HF/open-instruct-xxl and Llama-3-70b-qat; populate benchmark dashboard with precision/recall/hallucination slices. Deliver initial readout 2026-09-30.
3) Sales/CS (Ben) — create HubSpot milestone & invite OptimaPay to 09/30 interim readout; prepare slide 1: parity vs prop baseline (focus on hallucination examples and per-slice deltas).

Notes: keep the prompt bundle conservative — do not include any customer PII in the shared examples. Use the attached prompt_set_v1.jsonl as the canonical set.

Ben
Ben Carter
